$comment: Project-level Claude Code settings, versioned. Machine-specific grants go to settings.local.json (git-ignored). 'hooks', 'ask', 'deny', the git entries of 'allow', 'attribution', and 'disableAllHooks' and 'permissions.defaultMode', which stay unset, came from the kit and stay as the kit wrote them (ADR 0028); since 2026-11-10 this repository holds the kit's files itself (ADR 0074), so nothing copies or compares them here; the other 'allow' entries and this comment are MindfulnessReminder's. 'allow' covers git commit, which the PreToolUse hook lets through only on a claude/ branch (the kit's rule "Commits and merges", ADR 0021); 'ask' makes every merge, push, rebase, tag and forced branch delete (branch -D) prompt the owner, whatever was approved earlier (the same rule, ADR 0013); a merged branch is deleted with branch -d, which 'allow' covers. 'attribution' is empty so Claude Code adds no Co-Authored-By or PR line, which the same rule forbids. Hooks: PreToolUse refuses a git commit the model attempts off a claude/ branch, runs verify before the others and blocks --no-verify; PostToolUse records which files this session edited; Stop refuses to end a turn that edited code (the folders process.json names) until verify ran green (ADR 0036; ADR 0020). The project's own 'allow' entries leave out dotnet run and MindfulnessReminder.exe on purpose: any start of a build other than exactly --preview or --detect is a full tray start, which repairs the auto-start entry to that build's path (R-006), so each such start asks first.
